headline: Granted twelve water and sewer bill abatements ranging from $175.85 to $5,830.97.
summary: The commission held hearings on multiple requests for water and sewer bill abatements, mostly due to toilet flappers, leaks, or meter issues. All requests presented were granted with unanimous votes. One case was cancelled and five were no-shows, with two rescheduled to later months.
decisions: Granted abatement of $301.56 to Yania Gao, 81 Taylor St, for January 2026.
Granted abatement of $2,328.89 to Ishina Balwani, 75 Lebanon St, for December 2025 & January 2026.
Granted abatement of $175.85 to Brian Rabin, 64 Chandler Road, for December 2025 & January 2026.
Granted abatement of $530.17 to Lorraine Blanch, 80 Boylston St, for November, December 2025 & January 2026.
Granted abatement of $317.53 to Juan A. Flores, 478 Ferry St, for December 2025 & January & February 2026.
Granted abatement of $5,830.97 to Vipul Patel, ANKUR, INC., 321 Broadway, for January & February 2026.
Granted abatement of $391.36 to Sharmin Ahmed, 27 Ridgehill Avenue, for January 2026.
Granted abatement of $1,378.72 to Touch Sinn, 20 Roberts St, for January and February 2026.
Granted abatement of $1,591.75 to Provident Realty Trust, 105 Broadway, for January 2026.
Granted abatement of $357.52 to National Grid, 170 Medford St.
Granted abatement of $2,947.77 to Crestview Drive - Ledgewood Condo Association.
